tasks.description: Post about FAVOUR on X in your own words: what you did or what you earned. Proof: one screenshot of your LIVE post showing your handle, the text and the timestamp, plus the post URL in your proof note. Template copy or AI-written posts earn nothing.
Post the most surprising thing about FAVOUR so far, on X, in your own words. Proof: one screenshot of the live post (handle + timestamp visible) and the post URL in your proof note.
Post what you'd tell a friend who has never used FAVOUR, on X. Honest beats polished. Proof: one screenshot of the live post (handle + timestamp visible) and the post URL in your proof note.
